paraphrase: Alert and calm is right; indeterminate calm is wrong; calm and alert is right; confused-thought alertness is wrong.

paraphrase: Confused thinking is a sickness and indeterminate dullness is a sickness; calm is a medicine and alertness is a medicine: calm cures confused thinking but, alone, produces dullness; alertness cures dullness but, alone, produces confused thinking; so calm is the aid and alertness the main thing.

original.text: 亂想是病。無記亦病。寂寂是藥。惺惺亦藥
